metadata.title: Stock Market, AI Selloff, Jobs Report | November 6 Barron’s Daily<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Expect More Fireworks as Markets Adjust to the New AI Reality
Good morning from London where we celebrated Guy Fawkes’ centuries-old failure to blow up our parliament, last night. U.S. markets had less success preventing an explosive wipeout yesterday, although there seems to be something of a rebound in Friday’s premarket ahead of the jobs report.
